name: akeyless-trusted-access
description: Akeyless Trusted Access Layer for Codex — secrets injected at runtime, never exposed to the model

interface.shortDescription: Secure secrets and infrastructure access for Codex without exposing credentials to the model
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Akeyless as a trusted access layer. List environment variables, run commands with JIT secret injection, query databases and cloud services via Runtime Authority (ARA), migrate hardcoded secrets, and generate safe akeyless:// references — all without putting secret values in the model context.
defaultPrompt: List my Akeyless environment variables and run npm test with secrets injected.
Scan this repo for hardcoded secrets and migrate them to Akeyless.
List ARA secrets and describe what infrastructure I can access secretlessly.
